name: Oxwich Bay Hotel
stayType: Beachfront hotel with pods and cottage
accommodation: Old Rectory Rooms, Secret Garden Pods, The Ivy Cottage and Beach Walk Parc
beachAccess: Beachfront, with the beach on the doorstep
confirmedFeatures: Cafe bar and bistro open from 8am, evening dining, dog-friendly snug, cashless venue
overview: The Oxwich Bay Hotel sits right on the beach at Oxwich, with the sand on its doorstep. You can stay in rooms in the Old Rectory, garden pods, a cottage or at Beach Walk Parc, and the cafe bar and bistro serve food from breakfast until evening.
surfTripFit: You can check the water from the hotel and be in the sea in minutes. Food is on site and dogs are welcome.
